name: DG Medical
old_description: Although the name DG Medical was only adopted in 2010, the plastics molding expertise of the DG Medical team has been going strong for more than 30 years as part of the long-established DimcoGray Corporation, who specializes in the manufacture of thermoplastic and thermoset commercial and industrial knobs and handles. Having long been a trusted supplier of superior quality plastic molded components to many of the world’s leading medical device OEMs for years, establishing DG Medical as a full service contract manufacturer of medical devices was a natural off-shoot. Today, DG Medical is FDA Registered and ISO 13485 registered. DG Medical understands medical polymers, mold design and plastic molding processes, so our seasoned team of medical molding experts provides you with the best solution for bringing your product from conception design to production.
about:
DG Medical operates from Centerville, Ohio, and was established in 2010 as a dedicated medical device contract manufacturer. The business grew out of DimcoGray Corporation, a long-standing producer of thermoplastic and thermoset knobs and handles, giving the team more than 30 years of plastics molding experience before the DG Medical name was adopted. No founders are named in public records, and the ownership structure is not disclosed beyond the DimcoGray connection.

The company provides molding solutions, assembly, prototyping, and packaging services for medical devices. Its molding operations use process control technology to monitor production, while prototyping includes 3-D printed models from customer designs. Packaging lines combine automated and manual processes, and engineering support covers mold design and material selection. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not publicly disclosed.

DG Medical serves medical device original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), describing its customer base as many of the world's leading medical device companies. Specific client names are not provided.

The firm emphasizes its FDA registration and ISO 13485 certification, along with full traceability throughout production, as key differentiators. The move to create a separate medical division was described as a natural off‑shoot after years of supplying molded components to the medical industry, leveraging deep knowledge of medical polymers and mold design.
